descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Che tu stia cercando di iniziare la tua carriera o di acquisire la prima esperienza pratica in un nuovo campo, uno stage a On ti offre un'esperienza di crescita unica, la possibilità di fare un impatto dal primo giorno e contribuire al viaggio di crescita On.s. Siamo alla ricerca di idee fresche, menti curiose e persone appassionate pronte a fare la differenza. I nostri stage generalmente durano sei mesi e sarete completamente incorporati in una squadra.

- Data di inizio: 1 Marzo 2026 - Durata: Sei mesi - Prerequisito: Interesse per l'area relativa allo stage, passione per On, diritto di lavorare in UE / Svizzera - Nota: Questo è uno stage pagato - Se non si soddisfa i criteri di cui sopra, purtroppo, non possiamo andare avanti con la vostra domanda. Si prega di essere sinceri nelle vostre risposte, il reclutatore che rivede la vostra domanda apprezzerà la vostra onestà.

Curioso della vita come stagista a On? Vi consigliamo di guardare la registrazione del nostro precedente livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq) per ascoltare ex stagisti condividere la loro esperienza di stage, ottenere un insider.s guardare diversi dipartimenti e raccogliere alcuni suggerimenti e trucchi dai nostri reclutatori per aiutarvi ad affrontare il processo di applicazione.

Incontra la squadra

Il team di Sales Planning dell'EMEA Wholesale svolge un ruolo chiave nel guidare il business dalla previsione finanziaria a lungo termine alla pianificazione mensile delle vendite. Il team gestisce le performance in-stagione per garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi e supporta la pianificazione dell'assortimento pre-stagione per ottimizzare le strategie di prodotto e account. Lavorando in modo cross-funzionale con Sales, Controllo, Pianificazione della domanda e Operazioni, il team assicura l'allineamento tra obiettivi commerciali ed esecuzione operativa.

Si tratta di una funzione innovativa e in continua evoluzione, che migliora continuamente processi e strumenti per migliorare le performance e l'agilità aziendali.

La tua missione

• Eseguire analisi aziendali settimanali e generare approfondimenti a livello operativo per supportare i team di Sales and Management nel processo decisionale.

• Contribuire alle attività di pianificazione delle vendite, comprese le previsioni finanziarie, il monitoraggio in stagione e la pianificazione dell'assortimento pre-stagione.

• Migliorare e sviluppare strumenti e file analitici (ad esempio, dashboard di vendita, roll-up di previsione, tracker di fatture, G2N per regione/sottoregione) per consentire maggiori decisioni di vendita basate sui dati.

• Sostenere e guidare progetti relativi alle vendite volti a migliorare processi, strumenti e l'efficienza generale dei reparti.

• Supporto allo sviluppo di capacità AI all'interno della funzione commerciale.

La tua storia

• Dimostrare una mentalità proattiva e imprenditoriale, prendendo l'iniziativa e la proprietà di compiti con un atteggiamento. can-do.

• Hai forti capacità analitiche e un approccio basato sui dati per sostenere il processo decisionale e identificare le opportunità di business.

• Un risolutore naturale di problemi, capace di navigare nell'ambiguità e trovare soluzioni creative e pratiche.

• Curioso e desideroso di imparare, mostrando un interesse autentico per la comprensione dei processi di vendita e delle dinamiche aziendali.

• Pensi fuori dagli schemi e abbraccia le sfide oltre la tua zona di comfort per guidare l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo.

Cosa offriamo

Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera di supporto e orientata al team, con l'accesso alla cura personale di sé per il benessere sia fisico che mentale, così ogni persona è guidata da uno scopo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In short

Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day one and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last six months and you will be fully embedded in a team.

- Start date: March 1st 2026
- Duration: Six months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq ) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process.

Meet the team

The Sales Planning team within the EMEA Wholesale department plays a key role in driving the business from long-range financial forecasting to monthly sales planning. The team manages in-season performance to ensure targets are met and supports pre-season assortment planning to optimize product and Accounts strategies. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Controlling, Demand Planning, and Operations, the team ensures alignment between commercial goals and operational execution. It is an innovative and constantly evolving function, continuously improving processes and tools to enhance business performance and agility.

Your mission

• Perform weekly business analyses and generate actionable insights to support the Sales and Management teams in decision-making.

• Contribute to sales planning activities, including financial forecasting, in-season tracking, and pre-season assortment planning.

• Enhance and develop analytical tools and files (e.g., sell-out dashboards, forecast roll-ups, invoice trackers, G2N by region/sub-region) to enable more data-driven sales decisions.

• Support and drive sales-related projects aimed at improving processes, tools, and overall department efficiency.

• Support on developing AI capabilities within the commercial function.

Your story

• Demonstrate a proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, taking initiative and ownership of tasks with a “can-do” attitude.

• You have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to support decision-making and identify business opportunities.

• A natural problem solver, able to navigate ambiguity and find creative, practical solutions.

• Curious and eager to learn, showing genuine interest in understanding sales processes and business dynamics.

• You think outside the box and embrace challenges beyond your comfort zone to drive innovation and continuous improvement.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

Das Team treffen

Das Vertriebsplanungsteam der EMEA-Großhandelsabteilung spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Steuerung des Geschäfts von der langfristigen Finanzprognose bis zur monatlichen Vertriebsplanung. Das Team verwaltet die Leistung der Saison, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ziele erreicht werden, und unterstützt die Vorsaison-Sortimentplanung zur Optimierung der Produkt- und Account-Strategien. Das Team arbeitet funktionsübergreifend mit Sales, Controlling, Demand Planning und Operations.

Es ist eine innovative und sich ständig weiterentwickelnde Funktion, die kontinuierlich Prozesse und Werkzeuge verbessert, um die Geschäftsleistung und Agilität zu verbessern.

Ihre Mission

• Führen Sie wöchentliche Unternehmensanalysen durch und generieren Sie durchführbare Erkenntnisse, um die Vertriebs- und Managementteams bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.

• Beitrag zu den Aktivitäten der Vertriebsplanung, einschließlich Finanzprognosen, In-Saison-Tracking und Vorsaison-Sortiment-Planung.

• Verbesserung und Entwicklung analytischer Werkzeuge und Dateien (z.B. Ausverkaufs-Dashboards, prognostizierte Roll-ups, Rechnungentracker, G2N nach Region/Subregion), um mehr datengesteuerte Verkaufsentscheidungen zu ermöglichen.

• Unterstützung und Antrieb von Vertriebsprojekten zur Verbesserung von Prozessen, Werkzeugen und Gesamteffizienz der Abteilung.

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von KI-Fähigkeiten innerhalb der kommerziellen Funktion.

Ihre Geschichte

• Demonstration einer proaktiven und unternehmerischen Denkweise, Initiative ergreifen und die Verantwortung für Aufgaben mit einer, can-do, Haltung.

• Sie verfügen über starke analytische Fähigkeiten und einen datenorientierten Ansatz, um Entscheidungen zu unterstützen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.

• Ein natürlicher Problemlöser, der in der Lage ist, Unklarheiten zu navigieren und kreative, praktische Lösungen zu finden.

• Neugierig und lernfreudig, zeigt echtes Interesse am Verständnis von Verkaufsprozessen und Geschäftsdynamik.

• Sie denken außerhalb der Box und nehmen Herausforderungen über Ihre Komfortzone hinaus, um Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu fördern.

Was wir anbieten

Wir bieten ein Umfeld, das den Menschen die Werkzeuge bietet, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln – aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovativ zu sein. Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz verbindet eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit dem Zugang zur persönlichen Selbstversorgung für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, sodass jede Person nach dem Ziel geführt wird.

Designazione delle merci

In breve

Il nostro team di TT (HR) si sta espandendo fortemente per sostenere la crescita esplosiva di On.s, e stiamo cercando una persona entusiasta di unirsi a noi come Senior Payroll Specialist nel Team Operazioni di TT. Questo ruolo è per qualcuno che ha esperienza nelle operazioni di Payroll, idealmente in un ambiente veloce-paced, scala-up e retail. Il ruolo è ideale per chi gode di ricerca nuove sfide, apprezza un processo semplificato e di supporto, e ha una passione per soluzioni innovative.

La tua squadra

Essere parte del team di Quint On significa fare le cose in modo diverso, non facciamo le cose solo perché sono ciò che fa HR. Costruiamo, cresciamo, abilitare e responsabilizziamo il team per guidare il futuro di On. Il team di Operazioni di Quint si sforza di creare e fornire un'esperienza dipendente senza soluzione di continuità e positiva in ogni momento. Perché questo è ciò che conta per noi. Perché siamo On.

Missione

- Elaborazione e gestione del ciclo di salari end-to-end in Francia, Italia, Spagna e Portogallo, garantendo l'accuratezza e il rispetto delle normative pertinenti: - Preparazione dei contributi ai salari per i vostri venditori esterni, tra cui retribuzione regolare, straordinari, bonus, benefici in natura e detrazioni applicabili - Revisione dei progetti di salari forniti dai venditori esterni, garanzia di precisione dei salari in allineamento con le norme locali sui salari - Gestione di diversi orari di paga incl.

Al dettaglio e garantire pagamenti salariali tempestivi e distribuzione payslip - Consegna di rapporti di paga di fine mese al team finanziario, conciliare i conti di paga e risolvere eventuali discrepanze identificate insieme con Finanza - Responsabile per l'iscrizione dei nostri membri del team in prestazioni locali, come l'assicurazione sanitaria e regimi pensionistici.

Affrontare le richieste e le questioni relative ai salari dei dipendenti e dei dirigenti aziendali in modo tempestivo e professionale - Preparare per legge documenti obbligatori dei salari come Attestation employeeur, Certificat de travail e altri a seconda delle specifiche del paese - Collaborare con squadre di TT e Finance per garantire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra i salari, sistemi HR & Finance - Propriezzare la soluzione specifica per l'integrazione dei dati o dei dati feed tra sistemi On (Working) e fornitori esterni di buste paga - Comunicazione con le autorità, le assicurazioni e altri fornitori di prestazioni nei rispettivi paesi -

Il secondo programma di lavoro è stato realizzato con il sostegno di gruppi interni quali specialisti delle risorse umane, partner commerciali e Total Rewards, per portare avanti nuove iniziative.

- Progettare il processo di compilazione dei salari nei rispettivi paesi in allineamento con i controlli interni SOX e contribuire alla continua ottimizzazione e automazione dei processi e dei sistemi di gestione dei salari esistenti - Impostare operazioni di gestione dei salari in nuovi mercati/enti, in collaborazione con leader regionali, HR Specialist locale e altri internal On team - Eseguire verifiche periodiche dei registri dei salari per garantire l'accuratezza e la conformità - Responsabile del nostro ESS (equity) e dei vantaggi collaterali attraverso il registro dei salari - Garantire il rispetto di impostazioni occupazionali più complesse, come l'occupazione transfrontaliera o

casi di ricollocazione - Eagerness per assumere più soldi paesi, come apriamo nuovi mercati.

La tua storia

- 4+ anni di esperienza lavorativa in salari in Francia o in Italia. Ogni altro paese è un plus - Esperienza in salari per la popolazione al dettaglio per uno qualsiasi dei paesi di ambito è un enorme plus - Eccellente conoscenza operativa, legislativa e delle migliori pratiche salari in Francia o in Italia - Eccellente gestione delle parti interessate, attenzione ai dettagli, utilizzato per la gestione dei dati riservati, e approccio analitico - Esperienza lavorando con fornitori esterni di salari - Eccellente eccellenza competenze - Fluenza in inglese e almeno un'altra lingua locale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In short

Our Talent (HR) team is heavily expanding to support On’s explosive growth, and we are looking for an enthusiastic person to join us as Senior Payroll Specialist in the Talent Operations Team. This role is for someone who has experience in Payroll Operations, ideally in a fast-paced, scale-up and retail environment. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys researching new challenges, appreciates a streamlined and supportive process, and has a passion for innovative solutions. While France & Italy will be your main focus, you will also support other EMEA entities.

Your Team:

Being part of the Talent team at On means doing things differently, we don’t do things just because they are what “HR does”. We build, grow, enable and empower the team to drive the future of On. The Talent Operations team strives to create and deliver a seamless and positive employee experience at all times. Because this is what matters to us. Because we are On.

Mission:

• Process and manage the end-to-end payroll cycle in France, Italy, Spain and Portugal, ensuring accuracy and compliance with relevant regulations:

• Preparation of payroll input for your external vendors, including regular pay, overtime, bonuses, benefit in kind and applicable deductions

• Reviewing the payroll drafts provided by the external vendors, ensuring payroll accuracy in alignment with local payroll regulations

• Managing different payroll schedules incl. Retail and ensuring timely salary payments and payslip distribution

• Delivering month-end payroll reports to the finance team, reconcile payroll accounts and resolve any discrepancies identified together with Finance

• Responsible for enrolling our team members into local benefits, such as health insurance and pension schemes.Address payroll-related inquiries and issues from employees and business leaders in a timely and professional manner

• Prepare by law mandatory payroll documents such as Attestation employeur, Certificat de travail and others depending on the country specifics

• Collaborate with Talent and Finance teams to ensure seamless integration between payroll, HR & Finance systems

• Own the country specific solution for data integration or data feed between On systems (Workday) and external payroll vendor

• Communication with authorities, insurances and other benefit providers in respective countries

• Collaboration with internal teams such as HR specialists, Business Partners and Total Rewards, to drive forward new initiatives.

• Design the payroll process in your respective countries in alignment with internal SOX controls, and contribute to the continuous optimization and automation of existing payroll process and systems

• Set up of payroll operations in new markets/entities, in collaboration with regional lead, local HR Specialist and other internal On teams

• Conduct regular audits of payroll records to ensure accuracy and compliance

• Responsible for our ESS (equity) and fringe benefits reporting through payroll

• Ensure compliance with more complex employment setups, such as cross-border employment or relocation cases

• Eagerness to take over more payroll countries, as we open new markets.

Your story:

• 4+ years work experience in payroll in France or Italy. Any other country is a plus

• Experience in payroll for Retail population for any of the countries of scope is a huge plus

• Excellent operational, legislative and best practice payroll knowledge in France or Italy

• Excellent stakeholder management, attention to detail, used to handling confidential data, and analytical approach

• Experience working with external payroll providers

• Excellent excel skills

• Fluency in English and at least one other local language. Any other language is a plus

Fälle von Standortverlagerungen - Eagerness, mehr Lohn- und Gehaltszahl Länder zu übernehmen, während wir neue Märkte öffnen.

- 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Lohnbuchhaltung in Frankreich oder Italien. Jedes andere Land ist ein Plus - Erfahrung in der Lohnbuchhaltung für die Einzelhandelsbevölkerung in einem der Länder des Geltungsbereichs ist ein großes Plus - Ausgezeichnete operative, legislative und Best Practice Lohnbuchhaltung Kenntnisse in Frankreich oder Italien - Ausgezeichnete Stakeholder-Management, Liebe zum Detail, verwendet, um vertrauliche Daten zu behandeln, und analytische Ansatz - Erfahrung mit externen Lohnbuchhaltung Anbieter - Ausgezeichnete hervorragende Fähigkeiten - Fließfähigkeit in Englisch und mindestens eine andere lokale Sprache. cas de réinstallation - Eagerness pour prendre en charge plus de pays de paie, alors que nous ouvrons de nouveaux marchés.

In short:

The Senior Specialist - Procurement Category Manager Consumables role will report to Senior Lead - Procurement Category Manager, Logistics on the Global Procurement team supporting the Global Supply Chain Transformation region/function/product. As our Sr. Specialist Procurement Category Consumables, you will be tasked with supporting the strategic sourcing and category management for high-impact consumables. Your primary focus will be managing categories such as corrugate, specialized packaging materials, and other warehouse consumables essential to our global distribution network across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas.

Your Mission:

• Category Strategy: Develop and execute flexible category management support for consumables, specifically focused on corrugate, tape, void fill, and other essential packing materials.

• Sourcing & RFP Management: Lead sourcing activities and business case creation for packaging initiatives, ensuring all decisions are supported by rigorous analysis and sustainability goals.

• Vendor Management: Establish and maintain strong relationships with global packaging vendors to ensure operational visibility, quality control, and accountability.

• Value Engineering: Proactively identify and execute value engineering opportunities to optimize packaging design, reduce waste, and drive total cost of ownership (TCO) reduction.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate regular meetings with stakeholders from supply chain, operations, and finance to ensure alignment on consumables specs, lead times, and inventory levels.

• Operational Reporting: Create and standardize internal reports to drive continuous visibility into spend, multi-channel packaging usage, and supplier performance.

• Continuous Improvement: Troubleshoot issues within the consumables supply chain and develop action plans to drive business optimization and cost savings.

• Innovation Support: Work closely with product and sustainability teams to test and implement new, eco-friendly packaging materials that align with On's mission.

Your Story:

• Packaging Expertise: Ability to understand and articulate operational root cause analysis as it relates to packaging performance and distribution efficiency.

• Commercial Credibility: Skill to quickly build credibility and trust with external vendors and internal stakeholders during technical and commercial negotiations.

• Value Creation: A self-starter who proactively seeks business optimization and cost savings through data-driven business cases.

• Accountability: Ability to maintain and track critical action items and serves as a ‘single source of truth’ for consumables data.

• Resilience & Diplomacy: Capacity to be a change agent, demonstrating persistence and resiliencies when navigating market fluctuations in raw materials.

Attributes of a successful candidate:

• Strong demonstrated ability to work independently, manage data-intensive projects, and engage remote teams.

• Excellent discretion, judgment, tact, and diplomacy when dealing with sensitive commercial information.

• Solid business judgment, including the ability to anticipate the impact of procurement decisions on the global supply chain.

• Must demonstrate an energetic, positive, helpful demeanor and a passion and interest in On Running.

• A Bachelor’s degree; however, a combination of college education and related work experience may be used as a substitute.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in procurement, category management, or a specialized packaging role in a fast-paced environment.

• Expert knowledge and proficiency with MS Office applications.

Your Team:

You are part of the Global Supply Chain team, reporting into the Sr. Lead Procurement Category Manager Outbound. In this role, you will work and collaborate with various functions, including Inbound/Outbound Logistics, Finance, IT, and Legal. You will be actively collaborating with team members across both regional and global teams, as well as our 3rd party logistic partners (3PLs) and packaging suppliers.

We offer a dynamic, challenging and sportive environment that has been ranked as the ‘fastest growing sports company’ of its time. With offices across the globe, we are an international team who is hungry to innovate and build something incredible. We foster an active environment where each individual thrives for excellence and can achieve their full potential. This is where your work matters, you’re hands-on and your team members are amongst the very best in their respective disciplines and fields.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

Votre mission

• Leadership intersectoriel des intervenants : Diriger et gérer les relations interfonctionnelles des intervenants, en tant que partenaire stratégique clé pour canaliser les dirigeants et les chefs de la planification des ventes dans l'ensemble du commerce de gros, du DtC-Ecom et du DtC-Retail afin d'assurer une exécution commerciale unifiée et une planification de bout en bout.

• Optimisation des prévisions : Augmenter la précision des prévisions et minimiser les occasions de vente manquées. Vous y arriverez en traduisant intelligemment et rapidement les tendances de vente et les perspectives du marché en ajustements dynamiques des plans et des prévisions ouvertes à l'achat.

• Planification intelligente adaptée à l'IA : Championne de l'adoption et de l'intégration de l'IA et de l'analyse avancée des données dans nos processus de planification afin de permettre une planification intelligente, d'optimiser le flux d'inventaire et d'améliorer les capacités de prise de décisions prédictives dans toute la région.

• Leadership et perfectionnement de l'équipe : Dirigez, mentorez et inspirez directement une équipe hautement performante de responsables de la planification des marchandises, favorisant une culture de responsabilité axée sur les données et d'excellence opérationnelle.

Votre histoire

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience de leadership progressif dans la planification, la prévision ou la stratégie commerciale des marchandises, de préférence dans les industries de la chaussure, du sport ou de la mode.

• Forte acuité technique, avec une compréhension approfondie de l'architecture des données et de l'expérience pratique en tirant parti des outils de planification de l'IA et des modèles avancés de prévision pour produire des résultats commerciaux.

• Une présence exceptionnelle de la direction et des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d'influencer les équipes interfonctionnelles et les cadres supérieurs aux niveaux mondial et régional.

• Un état d'esprit entrepreneurial - vous êtes à l'aise de naviguer des défis de planification structurés et non structurés, de diriger des équipes par l'ambiguïté et d'agir de manière autonome pour faire avancer l'entreprise.

Rencontrez l'équipe

Vous dirigerez l'équipe de planification des marchandises de l'EMEA et travaillerez aux côtés des principales fonctions de direction dans les domaines des ventes, du commerce électronique et du commerce de détail, et de la planification de la demande, en mettant clairement l'accent sur le cycle de vie et la rentabilité des produits. Che tu stia cercando di iniziare la tua carriera o di acquisire la prima esperienza pratica in un nuovo campo, uno stage a On ti offre un'esperienza di crescita unica, la possibilità di fare un impatto dal primo giorno e contribuire al viaggio di crescita On.s. Siamo alla ricerca di idee fresche, menti curiose e persone appassionate pronte a fare la differenza. I nostri stage generalmente durano sei mesi e sarete completamente incorporati in una squadra.

- Data di inizio: 1 Marzo 2026 - Durata: Sei mesi - Prerequisito: Interesse per l'area relativa allo stage, passione per On, diritto di lavorare in UE / Svizzera - Nota: Questo è uno stage pagato - Se non si soddisfa i criteri di cui sopra, purtroppo, non possiamo andare avanti con la vostra domanda. Si prega di essere sinceri nelle vostre risposte, il reclutatore che rivede la vostra domanda apprezzerà la vostra onestà.

Curioso della vita come stagista a On? Vi consigliamo di guardare la registrazione del nostro precedente livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq) per ascoltare ex stagisti condividere la loro esperienza di stage, ottenere un insider.s guardare diversi dipartimenti e raccogliere alcuni suggerimenti e trucchi dai nostri reclutatori per aiutarvi ad affrontare il processo di applicazione.

La tua squadra

Siamo un piccolo team di finanza orientato all'azione con grandi responsabilità e impatto in tutta l'organizzazione. Evolviamo le migliori pratiche pensando al futuro, lavorando in modo trasversale e sfruttando le più recenti tecnologie per sostenere l'integrità, l'accuratezza e la trasparenza dei rapporti finanziari pubblicati esternamente da On.s. Il team di Group Reporting è responsabile per la rendicontazione finanziaria esterna di On.s, i bilanci consolidati, le politiche contabili e le questioni tecniche di contabilità, in conformità con le normative.

La tua missione

• Supporto con la preparazione di relazioni finanziarie trimestrali, semestrali e annuali archiviate presso la Commissione degli strumenti finanziari e di cambio (U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission) e pubblicate esternamente, in conformità con gli IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) e i regolamenti SEC. Aiuterai a garantire che le nostre informazioni finanziarie pubblicate esternamente siano accurate e conformi.

• Collaborare con Contabilità, Finanza, Legale, Controllo, Tesoro, Investor Relations e altri team per raccogliere dati critici e approfondimenti qualitativi per il nostro reporting.

• Assistenza nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di miglioramenti dei processi sfruttando l'AI e la tecnologia per semplificare e automatizzare i processi di reporting di gruppo.

• Assistenza con analisi ad hoc, progetti interfunzionali, attività di consolidamento mensile, politiche contabili e note tecniche di contabilità.

La tua storia

• Attualmente perseguendo un Bachelor.s o Master.s laurea in Contabilità, Finanza, o un campo correlato.

• Comprensione di base della contabilità (IFRS considerato a plus)

• Curioso di conoscere meglio il ruolo di AI e l'automazione in un dipartimento di finanza

• Forte capacità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi

• Altamente auto-motivato individuo con una mentalità positiva e. can-do.

• Eccellente attenzione ai dettagli, organizzazione e follow-through.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese
descriptionByLocale.en:
In short

Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day one and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last six months and you will be fully embedded in a team.

- Start date: March 1st 2026
- Duration: Six months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq ) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process.

Your team

We are a small, action-oriented Finance team with big responsibilities and impact across the organization. We evolve best practices by being forward-thinking, working cross-functionally, and leveraging the latest technology to uphold the integrity, accuracy, and transparency of On’s externally published financial reports. The Group Reporting team is responsible for On’s external financial reporting, consolidated financial statements, accounting policies, and technical accounting matters, in compliance with regulations.

Your mission

• Support with the preparation of quarterly, semi-annual, and annual financial reports filed with the SEC (U.S Securities and Exchange Commission) and published externally, in accordance with IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) and SEC regulations. You will help ensure our externally published financial information is accurate and in compliance.

• Partner and collaborate with Accounting, Finance, Legal, Controlling, Treasury, Investor Relations and other teams to gather critical data and qualitative insights for our reporting.

• Assist in developing and implementing process improvements by leveraging AI and technology to streamline and automate group reporting processes.

• Assist with ad-hoc analysis, cross-functional projects, monthly consolidation tasks, accounting policies, and technical accounting memos.

Your story

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Basic understanding of accounting (IFRS considered a plus)

• Curious to learn more about the role of AI and automation in a Finance department

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Highly self-motivated individual with a positive and “can-do” mindset.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Ihr Team

Ihre Mission

Sie helfen, sicherzustellen, dass unsere von außen veröffentlichten Finanzinformationen korrekt und entsprechend sind.

• Partner und Kooperation mit Accounting, Finance, Legal, Controlling, Treasury, Investor Relations und anderen Teams, um kritische Daten und qualitative Erkenntnisse für unsere Berichterstattung zu sammeln.

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Prozessverbesserungen durch die Nutzung von KI und Technologie zur Optimierung und Automatisierung von Gruppenberichterstattungsprozessen.

• Unterstützung bei der Ad-hoc-Analyse, funktionsübergreifenden Projekten, monatlichen Konsolidierungsaufgaben, Rechnungslegungsrichtlinien und technischen Rechnungslegungs-Memoranden.

Ihre Geschichte

• Derzeit verfolgt einen Bachelor, Master, Abschluss in Buchhaltung, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Grundlegendes Verständnis der Rechnungslegung (IFRS als Plus)

• Neugierig, mehr über die Rolle von KI und Automatisierung in einer Finanzabteilung zu erfahren

• Starke analytische und Problemlösungskompetenzen

• Hochselbst-motivierte Person mit einem positiven und, Can-do, Mindset.

• Ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail, Organisation und Follow-through.

• Starke schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Englischen

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

In breve:

La missione di On è diventare il marchio leader di abbigliamento sportivo di punta, radicato nel design, nelle prestazioni e nella sostenibilità.Per questo impegno, siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista dedicato dei dati di sostenibilità a Zurigo che sosterrà i nostri sforzi di dati per le nostre ambizioni e requisiti di sostenibilità.Contribuendo alla nostra contabilità annuale dei GHG, sarete responsabili della raccolta, convalida e calcolo dei dati di campo 1-3 e della costruzione di flussi di dati end-to-end per trasformare i dati grezzi in metriche attuabili.

Leveraging il tuo record di carbon accounting e ingegneria dei dati, eseguirai flussi di lavoro per la divulgazione dei dati e requisiti normativi. Collaborerai con gli stakeholder Tech e business per semplificare i flussi di lavoro e i sistemi, supportando i team di Product Sustainability, Traceability e Responsible Manufacturing con esigenze di dati. Se sei esperto di dati con un record di track record nella contabilità GHG e stai cercando di avere un impatto in un marchio di abbigliamento sportivo in crescita, questo ruolo è per te!

La tua missione

- Raccogliere, convalidare e calcolare i dati di campo 1-3 e gestire i rapporti con i proprietari dei dati. - Modelli e mappa dei flussi di dati di sostenibilità end-to-end dai sistemi di origine agli strumenti di reporting, trasformando i dati grezzi in metriche attuabili. - Identificare le opportunità di razionalizzare i flussi di lavoro e i sistemi in collaborazione con i team Tech. - Eseguire flussi di lavoro dati per la divulgazione della sostenibilità e requisiti normativi (ad esempio CSRD). - Supportare i team di produzione di prodotti di sostenibilità, tracciabilità e responsabilità con attività di raccolta dati, visualizzazione e ingegneria.

La tua storia

- Laurea in Scienze dei Dati, Ingegneria Ambientale, Sostenibilità o un campo correlato. - Min. 1 anno di esperienza in dati di sostenibilità con un track record in contabilità del carbonio, esperto in Protocollo GHG. - Capacità di codificare in Python per l'elaborazione dei dati e l'automazione dei compiti. - Esperienza con architetture BigQuery o data warehouse simili, compresa la scrittura e l'ottimizzazione delle query. - Proficienza negli strumenti di gestione dei dati (Excel, Google Sheets). - Forte comprensione delle metriche di sostenibilità, standard di reporting (come SBTi), e regolamenti globali.

- Alta attenzione ai dettagli con la capacità di strutturare e convalidare dati complessi. - Capacità di collaborare con team tecnici e stakeholder aziendali. - Fluenza in inglese. - Passione per la sostenibilità.

Incontra la squadra

Siamo un piccolo team con grandi responsabilità. Progettiamo e implementiamo la strategia di sostenibilità attraverso On e aiutiamo a modellare il futuro dell'organizzazione. Siamo ricercatori, creiamo strategie e implementare progetti e innoviamo prodotti e processi attraverso la lente della sostenibilità. Siamo l'hub strategico, fissando la direzione e il ritmo per l'impatto aziendale definendo priorità, obiettivi e politiche. Agiamo come educatori e attivatori interni, fornendo strumenti e formazione, e poi a 36 per il nostro progresso attraverso una comunicazione chiara internamente ed esterna.

Cosa offriamo

- Un ambiente dinamico classificato come "società sportiva in rapida crescita" dove il vostro lavoro influisce direttamente sulla nostra impronta globale. - Una cultura che promuove l'eccellenza e il potenziale. - Questo ruolo offre una profonda esposizione alla pianificazione strategica e alla crescita della conoscenza tecnica. - L'opportunità di costruire qualcosa di incredibile con una comunità globale collaborativa e ad alta energia dove si può veramente prosperare.

Se siete spinti a portare al livello successivo, curiosi circa l'opportunità e vogliono essere parte del nostro team in crescita inviaci la tua domanda, e unirsi all'ONIverse!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

In Short:

On's mission is to become the leading premium sportswear brand rooted in design, performance and sustainability. To drive this commitment, we are looking for a dedicated Sustainability Data Specialist in Zurich who will support our data efforts for our sustainability ambitions and requirements. Contributing to our annual GHG accounting, you will be responsible for collecting, validating, and calculating Scope 1-3 data, and building end-to-end data flows to transform raw source data into actionable metrics. Leveraging your track record in carbon accounting and data engineering, you will execute data workstreams for sustainability disclosure and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate with Tech and business stakeholders to streamline data workflows and systems, while supporting the Product Sustainability, Traceability, and Responsible Manufacturing teams with data needs. If you are data-savvy with a track record in GHG accounting and are looking to make an impact in a growing sportswear brand, this role is for you!

Your Mission

- Collect, validate, and calculate Scope 1-3 data and manage relationships with data owners.
- Model and map end-to-end sustainability data flows from source systems to reporting tools, transforming raw data into actionable metrics.
- Identify opportunities to streamline data workflows and systems in collaboration with Tech teams.
- Execute data workstreams for sustainability disclosure and regulatory requirements (e.g., CSRD).
- Support Product Sustainability, Traceability and Responsible Manufacturing teams with data collection, visualization, and engineering tasks.

Your Story

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related field.
- Min. 1 year of experience in sustainability data with a track record in carbon accounting, expert in GHG Protocol.
- Ability to code in Python for data processing and automation of tasks.
- Experience with BigQuery or similar data warehouse architectures, including writing and optimizing queries.
- Proficiency in data management tools (Excel, Google Sheets).
- Strong understanding of sustainability metrics, reporting standards (such as SBTi), and global regulations.
- High attention to detail with the ability to structure and validate complex data.
- Ability to collaborate with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
- Fluency in English.
- Passion for sustainability.

Meet The Team

We are a small team with big responsibilities. We design and implement the sustainability strategy across On and help shape the future of the organization. We do research, create strategies and implement projects and innovate products and processes through the lens of sustainability. We are the strategic hub, setting the direction and pace for corporate impact by defining priorities, targets, and policies. We act as internal educators and enablers, providing tools and training, and then amplify our progress through clear communication internally and externally.

What We Offer

- A dynamic environment ranked as a "fastest-growing sports company" where your work directly impacts our global footprint.
- A culture that fosters excellence and potential.
- This role offers deep exposure to strategic planning and technical knowledge growth.
- The chance to build something incredible with a collaborative, high-energy global community where you can truly thrive.

If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse!

Wenn Sie dazu getrieben werden, auf die nächste Ebene zu kommen, neugierig auf die Gelegenheit und wollen Teil unseres wachsenden Teams sein senden Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung, und kommen Sie in die ONIverse!

Désignation des marchandises

En confrontant à notre comptabilité annuelle des GES, vous serez responsable de la collecte, de la validation et du calcul des données de la portée 1-3 et de la construction de flux de données de bout en bout pour transformer les données brutes en mesures actionnables.

Vous travaillerez avec les techniciens et les intervenants commerciaux pour rationaliser les flux de données et les systèmes tout en soutenant les équipes de durabilité des produits, de traçabilité et de fabrication responsable qui ont besoin de données. Si vous êtes un expert en comptabilité des GES et que vous cherchez à faire un impact dans une marque de sportwear en croissance, ce rôle est pour vous!

Votre mission

- Collecter, valider et calculer les données de portée 1-3 et gérer les relations avec les propriétaires de données. - Modéliser et cartographier les flux de données de bout en bout sur la durabilité des systèmes sources aux outils de déclaration, transformer les données brutes en mesures exploitables. - Identifier les possibilités de rationaliser les flux de travail et les systèmes de données en collaboration avec les équipes techniques. - Exécuter les flux de données pour la divulgation de la durabilité et les exigences réglementaires (p. ex., CSRD). - Soutenir les équipes de durabilité des produits, de traçabilité et de fabrication responsable avec des tâches de collecte de données, de visualisation et d'ingénierie.

Votre histoire

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences des données, génie environnemental, durabilité ou un domaine connexe. - Expérience de 1 an d'expérience en données de durabilité avec un dossier de comptabilisation du carbone, expert en protocole de GES. - Capacité de coder en Python pour le traitement des données et l'automatisation des tâches. - Expérience avec BigQuery ou des architectures similaires de stockage de données, y compris l'écriture et l'optimisation des requêtes. - Compétence en outils de gestion des données (Excel, Google Sheets). - Connaissance approfondie des paramètres de durabilité, des normes de rapport (comme SBti) et des règlements mondiaux.

- Une grande attention aux détails avec la capacité de structurer et de valider des données complexes. - Capacité de collaborer avec les équipes techniques et les intervenants commerciaux. - Fluence en anglais. - Passion de durabilité.

Rencontrez l'équipe

In short As a Junior Apparel Developer at On, you will play an active role in bringing high-performance apparel to life, contributing to innovative products that meet the demands of elite athletes and the next generation of performance consumers. You’ll support the end-to-end development process across seasonal collections and special projects, collaborating closely with Design, Materials, Innovation, and Sourcing teams. You will join a small, agile development team focused on delivering world-class performance apparel. Working closely alongside a Senior Apparel Developer and Lead Developer, you will receive direct mentorship and hands-on guidance while taking responsibility for specific product areas. This provides a unique opportunity to accelerate your technical expertise, build your product knowledge, and contribute meaningfully to some of On's most innovative performance projects. With a sharp eye for detail, a solid foundational knowledge of garment construction, and a solutions-driven mindset, you’ll help ensure every product meets On’s high standards for performance, quality, fit, durability, and innovation. This role requires an effective communicator who is eager to learn, capable of managing assigned projects efficiently, and deeply passionate about developing technically advanced performance apparel. Your Mission:
• Support the development of a seasonal performance apparel collection, helping to create innovative products that meet the needs of athletes and performance consumers while reflecting On’s performance DNA.
• Assist and manage assigned stages of product development from concept through commercialization, ensuring products deliver against performance, innovation, quality, and athlete expectations under the guidance of senior team members.
• Collaborate with Design to create accurate, production-ready Tech Packs and ensure supplier instructions are clear, detailed, and aligned.
• Apply foundational construction techniques and seek technical solutions that meet design intent, performance requirements, fit standards, cost targets, and sustainability goals.
• Help execute fit, wear testing, and quality standards across assigned product ranges, ensuring products perform reliably under intended use conditions.
• Maintain product development documentation using Adobe Illustrator and PLM tools to manage detailed specifications, construction artwork, and material selections.
• Actively participate in fit sessions, bringing a strong standard of execution, technical curiosity, and growing competitor awareness.
• Partner with the Materials Developer to select and source materials that enhance performance, comfort, durability, and athlete experience.
• Maintain positive, collaborative relationships with key suppliers to ensure product quality, innovation, and production readiness.
• Make informed decisions within your assigned project scope, balancing design intent and technical feasibility while escalating complex issues appropriately.
• Manage assigned tasks concurrently, prioritizing effectively to deliver on timelines, quality, and cost goals with guidance from senior developers.
• Contribute to solving technical challenges related to construction, materials, fit, or production, showing a proactive attitude toward continuous process improvement.
• Develop foundational expertise in specialized performance categories, eagerly learning from senior colleagues to grow your technical knowledge.
• Collaborate effectively across functions including Design, Materials, Sourcing, Engineering, Innovation, Athlete Management, and external partners to support alignment from concept to production.
• Provide clear, timely product input and feedback to internal teams and suppliers, maintaining open and collaborative communication.
• Embrace a growth mindset by actively seeking feedback, reflecting on product outcomes, and fostering a collaborative, solution-focused team culture.
• Learn and apply costing principles, contributing to cost engineering efforts to meet commercial targets without compromising product performance or design intent. Your Story:
• Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Engineering, Sportswear Development, or a related technical field.
• 2+ years of experience in apparel development, ideally with an exposure to performance apparel, technical sportswear, or athlete-focused product.
• Strong interest in athlete needs and a growing ability to help translate performance requirements into commercially viable products.
• Good foundational knowledge of garment construction, basic pattern understanding, materials, and fit.
• Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a hands-on approach and openness to learning unconventional thinking.
• Proficient in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, PLM systems, and Microsoft Office tools.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and ambitious product innovation goals.
• Willingness to travel regularly between HQ and global development and manufacturing partners as needed.
• Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines.
• Excited to work within a small, highly collaborative team environment where learning, growth, and continuous development are prioritized.
• Highly motivated to learn from experienced technical leaders while progressively taking on more independent responsibility for complex product categories.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Short: On's success comes down to two reasons: incredible products - and incredible people. It has one simple mission: Ignite the Human Spirit Through Movement. Available today in over 50 countries and cited as “the fastest growing sports company in the world,” On shoes and Performance Running Gear have won design and technology distinctions the world over. As our Sr. Lead Distribution Procurement Category Manager , you will be responsible for the end-to-end strategic sourcing and category management of our global warehousing and distribution network. You will be tasked with developing long-term category strategies that support On’s rapid growth while ensuring operational excellence and cost efficiency across our Distribution & Logistics portfolio. Your Mission:
• Category Leadership: Develop and execute comprehensive category strategies specifically for warehousing and distribution services globally.
• Sourcing & RFP Management: Lead complex RFPs and sourcing events for 3PL providers, ensuring all decisions are supported by rigorous financial and operational analysis.
• Commercial Negotiation: Drive end-to-end contract negotiations, focusing on total cost of ownership (TCO), service levels (SLAs), and long-term scalability.
• Warehouse Operational Design: Support the procurement of automation and technology solutions (e.g., MHE, robotics) to drive distribution center efficiency.
• Network Optimization: Collaborate on business case creation for new node entries, facility expansions, or site relocations within the EMEA and global network.
• Vendor Excellence: Establish robust SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) frameworks to drive accountability and continuous improvement with our logistics partners.
• Labor & Consumables Strategy: Manage the procurement of indirect warehouse needs, including temporary labor contracts and packaging/consumables strategy.
• Operational Visibility: Create and maintain standardized reporting tools to track category spend, vendor performance, and contract compliance.
• Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate regular strategic alignment meetings with Supply Chain, Finance, and IT leadership to ensure procurement goals support the broader business roadmap.
• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify value-engineering opportunities to optimize our distribution footprint and drive sustainable cost savings. Your Story:
• Subject Matter Expertise: Deep understanding of the warehousing and 3PL landscape, including cost models, operational drivers, and industry benchmarks.
• Strategic Influence: Skill to quickly build credibility and trust with executive-level stakeholders and external partners.
• Analytical Precision: Ability to build data-driven business cases and perform complex root cause analysis to support sourcing recommendations.
• Process Discipline: Strong knowledge of procurement best practices, contract law, and project management methodologies.
• Accountability: Ability to serve as the ‘single source of truth’ for the distribution category, managing complex dependencies across the global network.
• Resilience: Capacity to act as a change agent, navigating market volatility and high-pressure negotiations with tact and diplomacy. Basic Qualifications:
• A Bachelor’s degree (a combination of college education and related work experience may be used as a substitute).
• Minimum 5 years of experience in strategic procurement, category management, or a specialized logistics role in a fast-paced environment.
• Expert knowledge and proficiency with MS Office applications and experience with sourcing tools (e.g., Ariba, Coupa, etc). Additional Skills:
• Strong demonstrated ability to work independently, manage data-intensive projects, and engage remote teams.
• Excellent discretion, judgment, and the capacity to handle sensitive commercial data.
• Solid business judgment, including the ability to anticipate the impact of procurement decisions on the end-to-end supply chain.
• Must demonstrate an energetic, positive, helpful demeanor and a passion for On Running. What We Offer: We offer a dynamic, challenging and sportive environment that has been ranked as the ‘fastest growing sports company’ of its time. With offices across the globe, we are an international team who is hungry to innovate and build something incredible. We foster an active environment where each individual thrives for excellence and can achieve their full potential. This is where your work matters, you’re hands-on and your team members are amongst the very best in their respective disciplines and fields. If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse! On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination. We are requesting that you provide sensitive demographic information such as gender identity and race/ethnicity to help us ensure that we are creating equitable and fair experiences for all potential future team members. In Short The world’s fastest-growing sports brand is seeking a passionate, hands-on Treasury expert to drive our global finance team forward. Working closely with colleagues across the globe, you will be a core part of On's Treasury function, helping to lead strategic projects and implementing new processes to support our global expansion. Reporting to the Head of Group Treasury, this is a pivotal role where you will own and drive innovation across our Treasury function. You are the go-to data expert, leveraging exceptional analytical and corporate finance modeling skills to go beyond the numbers, uncover the 'why', and transform complex data into clear, actionable insights. You will be the true product owner of our entire treasury technology stack (including Kyriba, Palm, Looker and Looker Studio, Big Query), championing innovation by embedding AI and automation into our daily operations. You will proactively challenge the wider team to redefine what is possible in the future of treasury, and play a crucial role in our journey to build a low-maintenance, high-value Treasury team. • You go beyond the numbers to uncover the 'why,' challenging assumptions and building strong relationships across the business to masterfully craft and communicate the compelling financial stories that guide our path.
• You architect and build our treasury-focused data lake, creating a single source of truth. You use this platform to design and maintain live, interactive dashboards that deliver real-time, actionable insights to Treasury and management.
• You act as the ultimate sparring partner for the Treasury Core function, challenging their models and assumptions, providing data-driven action plans to drastically improve forecasting accuracy, and actively helping define key KPIs for strategic cash, FX, and financing steering.
• You use your strong financial acumen to support high-impact corporate financial modeling requests, analyzing statements and creating sophisticated models that propel strategic decisions across the company.
• You champion innovation by relentlessly embedding AI and automation into our treasury operations, using data-driven insights to inspire and challenge the wider team to embrace new, low-maintenance, high-value technologies.
• You own and continuously enhance our core treasury technology stack (including Kyriba, Palm, Looker and Looker Studio, Big Query, and FXall), proactively identifying, driving, and implementing improvements necessary to accelerate our global growth. Your Story
• You are driven by a deep passion for data analytics and possess a natural talent for turning complex information into clear, actionable insights.
• We value your potential, analytical drive, and strong financial acumen most. While relevant professional experience from a role in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or a general Finance function is a bonus, your ability to perform ad hoc financial modeling, read and analyze financial statements, and assist with corporate finance models is key.
• You possess a solid knowledge of AI with a clear understanding of how to apply it to drive business value. You are an automation enthusiast who proactively builds workflows to eliminate manual tasks and streamline operations.
• You have a bias toward action and the attitude to try things out, iterate quickly, and find the best path forward.
• You bring an insatiable curiosity and a "tinker" mindset, with the initiative to experiment with new tools and learn through doing.

Social media is central to the On brand and key to connecting with our communities in a genuine way to communicate our brand mission ‘to ignite the human spirit through movement’. Running is at our core and as we continue to grow we’re looking for an experienced social media creative to bring to life our Running campaigns and athletes stories across Instagram, TikTok, Strava and YouTube. You’ll collaborate with global marketing, strategy, creative, digital and art direction teams to land our key campaigns with our running communities. Reporting to the Lead - Global Social Media , you’ll be key to creating compelling stories for our social channels. Your mission:
• Oversee all social media planning from conception to execution for our running campaigns, projects and events.
• Engage with our target communities through insight-led social content creation: with an ambition to disrupt run culture and deepen the connection to our athletes
• Develop and present brilliant ideas aimed at impacting running culture through social media to internal stakeholders
• Brief internal and external creative teams on socially-native content designed to entertain and be shared whilst maintaining a premium edge
• Comfortable capturing or directing content on campaign sets, as well as during live sporting eventsCollaborate closely with our internal athlete strategy team to concept and create insight-led stories with our world-class portfolio of athletes
• Demonstrate the ability to challenge conventions and the status quo, constantly seeking new ideas, methods, and technologies to improve social output Your story:
• 5+ years’ working in a social media content creation role
• You may have experience working as a social media manager or social creative / social art director
• Passionate about running. You have a deep understanding of what running means to different people of varying abilities, from your everyday runners to elite runners, and everything in between
• Comfortable working autonomously with the ability to communicate efficiently with stakeholders of varying seniority
• Ability to implement and work towards self-imposed deadlines and timings that align with wider teams
• Live and breathe social media, staying on top of the latest content formats and trends is a must
• Proven track record of developing ideas and content strategies to deliver views and engagement across key channels like TikTok, Instagram, Strava and YouTube
• Be proactive and collaborative, with experience working in a high-performing team
• Brief and manage external creative partners (photographers, content creators, agencies)
• Strong communication and writing skills - presenting ideas and plans to marketing, strategy, communication, production and creative teams
• You have the desire to produce best-in-class content and experience in producing or commissioning content yourself

In short: We are looking for an experienced internal comms expert, skilled at telling stories through innovative mediums as we drive the next chapter of strategic communication at On. Reporting to the Global Head of Internal Communications, the Head of Internal Content & Channels will lead the editorial strategy to reach our internal audience. This hands-on role will drive production of creative content across company-wide events, announcements, presentations, and other strategic moments. They will also lead complex innovation workstreams to build and improve the channels we use to communicate. This role will be highly embedded in On’s unique and entrepreneurial culture; collaborating with multiple teams and leaders to optimize information flow and bring great messages to life. Your mission:
• Leading the creative arm of the Internal Comms team – including concept development, editorial planning, narrative, and production.
• Partnering closely with internal creative teams and external vendors to produce premium video and multimedia content.
• Writing messages, speeches, and presentations for global audiences on key topics related to our strategy and culture.
• Driving innovation strategy for company-wide channels; scoping new formats and driving them forward from proposal to adoption. Your story: In addition to a specific passion for internal communication and culture, we hope you’ll also bring:
• 10+ years of experience working in creative and multi-disciplinary roles across Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
• Excellent writing skills. No matter the subject, you are able to easily identify a story and bring it to life in a clear and compelling way – through talking points, slides, videos, and other mediums.
• Thought leadership. You bring big ideas - and the strategic acumen to actually make them happen. You are skilled at translating your vision into words; bringing peers and stakeholders on board.
• Creativity. You bring expertise in at least one relevant audiovisual format (video, audio, graphic design, animation), and you find energy in a brainstorming session.
• Technical savvy. You are well-versed in tying measurement to an editorial strategy, and you regularly use agentic AI to enhance your creative workflows. You’re able to learn systems easily, identify gaps, and problem solve accordingly. Experience using Workvivo, Slack and G-Suite apps is a plus.
• Collaborative mindset. You enjoy leading large, cross-functional projects and tackling ambiguity with your strong organization skills. You’re an active participant in company culture and good at networking to build bridges across the business.
• Tons of motivation. You are a self-starter; always picking up new skills and happy to operate in the weeds.
• Industry knowledge. You regularly follow media trends and apply them to your work to engage employees of all backgrounds.
• English fluency. Additional languages are a plus. Meet the team: This role sits within Internal Communications – a team focused on driving connection and clarity across our global team at On. We’re big thinkers and change-makers, constantly looking for new ways to inform and inspire. If you’re passionate about impacting culture and applying your creativity in various areas of the business, you’ll be in great company.

In Short: Join our fast-growing global sports brand as a Senior Specialist - Real Estate Analysis for EMEA. We are accelerating our portfolio expansion of our own stores globally while also ensuring that the talented teams working in our offices have plenty of space to hire and grow together. In this role, you will ensure every decision is backed by rigorous data, every pro forma is accurate, and the transaction process moves with speed and precision. You will be instrumental in accelerating our portfolio expansion while optimizing our existing office and retail footprint. Your Mission: Market Research & Strategic Analysis
• Create comprehensive real estate analyses to advise the team on retail site selection. This includes generating reports on population growth, purchasing power, tourist traffic, footfall density, and competitor mapping.
• Go beyond the numbers by analyzing "soft metrics" such as the density of running/fitness communities, proximity to wholesale partners, and brand adjacencies to ensure locations match Ons values.
• Collect, synthesize, and analyze data from internal partners (E-commerce heatmaps, Sales performance, Marketing activations) and external broker partners to create benchmarks that ensure all real estate decisions are data-driven. Financial Modeling & Deal Feasibility
• Build and maintain detailed real estate financial models in cooperation with Finance, Construction, and Operations.
• Run scenario planning to stress-test financial assumptions before management approval. Transaction Management

descriptionByLocale.it: In short On is looking for a Senior Lead - Integrated Planning Platform to join our engineering team at our HQ in Zurich. We are seeking a leader who seamlessly combines deep, strategic Supply Chain Planning expertise with a strong software engineering / technical background. In this role, you will lead complex projects and a high-performing team that delivers large-scale planning system solutions—the digital backbone of our global supply chain. These systems impact several teams across functions and regions, ensuring On's products reach our customers efficiently. In our high-velocity culture, you will leverage your profound understanding of S&OP processes, demand and supply forecasting to scale a robust, world-class integrated planning environment. You will harness diverse perspectives from both business and tech stakeholders, anticipate bottlenecks, and confidently balance necessary technical and strategic trade-offs. Your Mission - Lead & Empower Teams : Lead, inspire, and grow engineering teams focused on the Integrated Planning Platform. Ensure the team has a clear mission aligned with On's global supply chain goals, encourage a collaborative environment, and balance managing the team closely with giving them the freedom to act with increasing autonomy. - Supply Chain & Platform Delivery : Be fully accountable for the delivery, timeline, quality, and hiring for your teams. Take on accountability for larger, more complex deliverables by managing risk, anticipating blockers, and addressing uncertainty. - Technical & Architectural Leadership : Be accountable for the team's technical decisions and solutions, acting as a key contributor to ensure they align with On Tech's architecture north star. You will guide the architecture to seamlessly handle complex supply chain data flows, enterprise system (e.g., ERP) integrations, and high-volume planning cycles. - Strategic Partnership : Partner tightly with E2E Planning business leaders, product managers, and project management to plan deliverables. You will translate complex supply chain business needs into scalable technical initiatives, define the scope of delivery, and ensure alignment on complex cross-team dependencies. - Operational Excellence : Ensure the reliable operation of your team's planning systems and adjacent ones in accordance with established SLOs. Prioritize the resolution of time-sensitive incidents that could impact critical planning and purchasing cycles, and enable iterative rollout, testing, and release engineering practices. - Culture & Values : Act as a role model for On's tech values and principles. Foster an inclusive multi-team environment that champions a culture of seeking out feedback and delivering praise. Your story - Supply Chain Planning Experience : Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree (or 8 years with a Master’s degree). You possess a profound background in the Supply Chain Planning domain, including deep functional knowledge of Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), demand planning, supply network planning, inventory management, and end-to-end supply chain visibility. - Technical Background : A strong engineering or technical background with a track record of driving impact. You have successfully built, scaled, or integrated enterprise planning architectures, ERP systems, and data-heavy applications in high-growth environments. - Bonus (Anaplan) : While your primary strength is in general technical supply chain planning, hands-on knowledge and experience with Anaplan (or similar enterprise planning platforms) is considered a strong plus. - People Leadership : Proven experience managing one or more teams of engineers/individual contributors. You have a track record of grooming high performers, actively managing team performance, and driving continuous improvement. - Navigating Complexity : Demonstrated ability to identify underlying business and technical issues, uncover root causes in complex supply chain data or processes, and deliver solutions to new problems across multiple domains. - Collaboration & Communication : Strong command of verbal and written communication. You adapt your style seamlessly for cross-functional initiatives, building strong collaborative relationships with technical peers, supply chain stakeholders, and senior leaders.
